'''Thrust Coils''' were [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] components that controlled a pod's top speeds. Some Thrust Coils included the [[Plug2 Thrust Coil|Plug]] [[Plug3 Thrust Coil|series]] [[Plug5 Thrust Coil|of]] [[Plug8 Thrust Coil|Thrust Coils]], and the [[Block5 Thrust Coil|Block]] [[Block6 thrust coil|Thrust Coil]] series. Better Thrust Coils granted better top speeds, but they would under-perform if damaged, and some [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] found that it was better to use an inferior Thrust Coil as opposed to racing with a damaged one.
